_help: Key-fact flashcards for the quiz. Each fact was checked against the linked source (as of Sept 2026). Add your own: { id, tags, q, a, source, url, asOf }.

facts.q: What was turnout at the 2024 UK general election?
How many seats did Labour win in 2024, and on what share of the vote?
How many seats did Reform UK win in 2024, and on what share of the vote?
How many women MPs were elected in 2024?
By how many votes did Reform UK win the Runcorn & Helsby by-election (May 2025)?
On what date did Andy Burnham become Prime Minister?
facts.a: 20 July 2026 (elected Labour leader unopposed on 17 July)

facts.q: Which by-election brought Andy Burnham into the Commons?
How many members does the Senedd now have, and how are they elected?
facts.a: 96, by closed-list PR (D'Hondt) in 16 six-member constituencies (first used May 2026)

facts.q: What was turnout at the May 2026 Senedd election?
facts.a: 51.6%, the highest ever for a Welsh devolved election

facts.q: Who became the first non-Labour First Minister of Wales in May 2026?
How many of the Scottish Parliament's 129 seats did the SNP win in May 2026?
When did the House of Lords (Hereditary Peers) Act receive Royal Assent?
facts.a: 18 March 2026 (the remaining hereditary peers left at the end of the session in April)

facts.q: What did the UK Supreme Court decide in For Women Scotland (April 2025)?
facts.a: 'Woman' and 'sex' in the Equality Act 2010 refer to biological sex

facts.q: What happened to the revived assisted dying bill on 11 September 2026?
facts.a: It was defeated at second reading, 270–286, on a free vote

facts.q: Which party won the Gorton & Denton by-election in February 2026?
facts.a: The Green Party (Hannah Spencer), a gain from Labour

facts.q: How many Labour MPs voted against the welfare bill at second reading on 1 July 2025?
facts.a: 49 (even after the PIP cuts were dropped)

facts.q: Roughly how many councillors did Reform UK gain in the May 2026 local elections?
What was the BBC's projected national share for the May 2026 local elections?
facts.a: Reform 26%, Green 18%, Labour 17%, Conservative 17%, Lib Dem 16%

facts.q: Who made a record £9m donation to Reform UK in Q3 2025?
Who became BBC Director-General in May 2026?
facts.a: Matt Brittin (after Tim Davie resigned in November 2025 over the Panorama Trump edit)

facts.q: When was Palestine Action proscribed as a terrorist organisation?
facts.a: July 2025 (the Commons approved it 385–26 on 2 July; it took effect on 5 July)

facts.q: Who won Labour's deputy leadership election in October 2025?
Who has led the Green Party of England and Wales since September 2025?
Which senior Conservative defected to Reform UK in January 2026?
facts.a: Robert Jenrick, on the day Kemi Badenoch sacked him

facts.q: What did the English Devolution and Community Empowerment Act 2026 create?
facts.a: A framework of 'strategic authorities' (such as combined authorities), some led by elected mayors (Royal Assent 29 April 2026)

facts.q: When did the two-child benefit limit end?
facts.a: From April 2026 (announced in the November 2025 Budget)

facts.q: After farmers' protests, what did the government raise the farm inheritance-tax relief threshold to (Dec 2025)?
How long was the US federal government shutdown of autumn 2025?
What was the longest funding lapse in US history?
What did the Supreme Court decide in Learning Resources v. Trump (20 Feb 2026)?
facts.a: The IEEPA emergency-powers law does not authorise tariffs (6–3)

facts.q: Which 1935 precedent did Trump v. Slaughter (June 2026) overrule?
What did Louisiana v. Callais (April 2026) do?
facts.a: Sharply narrowed Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act (6–3, opinion by Justice Alito)

facts.q: What did Trump v. Barbara (June 2026) decide?
facts.a: Struck down the executive order limiting birthright citizenship, 6–3. Roberts's majority opinion held it breaches the 14th Amendment; Kavanaugh agreed on other grounds

facts.q: What did NRSC v. FEC (June 2026) strike down?
facts.a: Limits on political parties' coordinated spending with candidates (overruling Colorado II, 2001)

facts.q: What share of California voters backed Prop 50 (redistricting) in November 2025?
By what margin did the House pass the Epstein Files Transparency Act (Nov 2025)?
facts.a: 427–1, after a discharge petition reached 218 signatures

facts.q: Which sitting US senator lost his primary runoff to Ken Paxton in May 2026?
How many executive orders did President Trump sign in 2025?
Which Republican congressman left the party to sit as an Independent in March 2026?
How was the Senate's Venezuela war-powers resolution defeated on 14 January 2026?
facts.a: 50–50, with Vice President Vance casting the tie-breaking vote

facts.q: What did the Supreme Court do in Trump v. Illinois (December 2025)?
facts.a: Refused to allow the National Guard deployment to Chicago

facts.q: Who won the November 2025 New York City mayoral election?
What share of the Supreme Court's October Term 2025 decisions were unanimous?
What did UN Security Council Resolution 2803 (17 Nov 2025) do?
facts.a: Endorsed the US-backed plan to end the Gaza conflict, welcomed the Board of Peace and authorised a temporary International Stabilization Force (13–0–2; China and Russia abstained)

facts.q: What defence-spending target did NATO allies agree at The Hague in June 2025?
facts.a: 5% of GDP by 2035 (3.5% core defence + 1.5% security-related)

facts.q: Which two NATO allies invoked Article 4 in September 2025?
facts.a: Poland (after Russian drone incursions) and Estonia (after Russian jets entered its airspace)

facts.q: Which states vetoed the Security Council draft on shipping through the Strait of Hormuz (7 April 2026)?
Which country won its first-ever Security Council seat in the June 2026 election?
Who topped the third Security Council straw poll for UN Secretary-General (18 Sept 2026)?
When did the US withdrawal from the Paris Agreement take effect?
When will the US withdrawal from the UNFCCC take effect?
Where and when is COP31, and who leads the negotiations?
facts.a: Antalya, Türkiye, 9–20 November 2026; Australia's Chris Bowen is 'President of Negotiations'

facts.q: Which country became ASEAN's 11th member in October 2025?
How did Karim Khan leave office as ICC prosecutor?
facts.a: He was removed by the ICC's Assembly of States Parties on 24 July 2026 for serious misconduct

facts.q: When does Rodrigo Duterte's trial open at the ICC?
facts.a: 30 November 2026 (charges of crimes against humanity were confirmed in April 2026)

facts.q: What legal basis did the EU use in December 2025 to immobilise Russian central-bank assets indefinitely?
facts.a: Article 122 TFEU (which needs only a qualified majority)

facts.q: Which G20 member was excluded from the 2026 summit hosted by the US?
Where was the 2026 BRICS summit held?
How much warming did UNEP's 2025 Emissions Gap Report project if countries meet their pledges?
